stop_rules: Freeze every ID and all trial conditions before the first fixture starts.
Exactly one standard public action is dispatched per trial; never replay a dispatched action.
If source action is UNKNOWN with release unconfirmed, preserve it; verify exact producer absence, then make at most one fresh-session public orphan recovery attempt.
Stop the cohort immediately if producer absence, target identity, release, neutral readback or configured late-input horizon is not verified; retain the target and durable fence.
Close a target only after normal terminal release plus neutral/horizon proof, or after successful orphan recovery confirms those conditions.
Preserve every failed/unknown attempt; no successful-subset analysis or retry.
Independent fixture scoring is factual only; post-expiry effects are not eligible task success.
workload: one focused A key chord to an owned visible Win32 fixture per independent process; the fixture schedules text a 6000ms after keydown; authority lease expires after 2000ms
